trade_offs: A git hunk that merges with a nearby edit gets a new digest, so its marker drops (conservative).
Renames change every digest because the path is part of the normalized hunk.
Binary and truncated files cannot be marked viewed.
The interdiff's rebased side is an in-memory tree: only revision-side comments are offered; narrowed views and ranges ending before the head disable commenting.
Narrowing reads the git change-id header, plus JjIntake's observation of a revision head commit when the header is absent.
